lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: Can I ask you something about the Sun?

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: How hot is the Sun inside?

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: Its core gets as hot as twenty-seven million degrees Fahrenheit.

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: It's so big that its gravity squeezes the hydrogen inside really hard. The hydrogen smashes together and turns into helium, and that gives off energy. Big word, small idea.
